sources.snippet: RoBERTa Classifier is a neural model that fine-tunes the RoBERTa transformer with tailored prediction heads for binary, multiclass, multilabel, and sequence labeling tasks. It utilizes advanced tokenization strategies such as BPE and SentencePiece to minimize out-of-vocabulary issues and ensure consistent labeling across diverse languages. sources.snippet: RoBERTa (Robustly Optimized BERT Pretraining Approach) is an encoder-only transformer model developed by Meta AI to improve the performance of the BERT model through optimized pretraining strategies.
